reviews.x: Small bottle  but a little goes a long way...my makeup lasted ALL day without me reapplying powder to my oily areas!!...NO MORE MAC for me! BTW, I am a black woman and I did not look ashy! It is truly translucent.

reviews.t: Amazon is NOT an authorized seller of Ben Nye products
reviews.x: Guys, I wouldn't order any Ben Nye products from amazon. Ben Nye does NOT authorize the sell of his products on amazon or ebay so there's a good chance you are buying fakes.

pretty good product but I do prefer the banana powder to this one although banana powder from Ben Nye is only really for setting concealer  ........ but still a good product for keeping your face matte

This is talc powder.  Buy some OTC for $2 and save your money on this one.  It's supposed to be sheer, but it does lighten your face when it's applied... so I used less and it doesn't cover/highlight/improve my appearance.  By lunch, I was shiny again.  My matte powder I buy OTC keeps me shine free all day ... this Ben Nye did not.  I returned this product.

I have had previous Ben Nye Translucent powders before but this is not Ben Nye. The consistency of it is off and this ben nye causes serious irritation.. you are better off buying from an official cosmetics store.

reviews.t: Good stuff, but broke me out :(
reviews.x: I wanted to like it.  After all the reviews, I wanted to give this a try.  First time putting it on was 7:30 AM, goes on clear, didn't give a white cast.  It worked like my mineral loose powder, kept me matte til around 12 PM.  Unfortunate, like ELF HD powder, this broke me out, gave me cystic bumps on and near my nose.  I didn't change anything in my routine except this, so I'm pretty sure it's the powder.  But everyone is different, I encourage ladies/gents to give this a try if haven't alread

I love this setting powder!  I use a cream foundation and put this over it and don't look back all day.  The only downside, but not worth losing a star, is I find the mouth too small to put a brush in.  With that said, it's very fine, so I just pour some on to a piece of aluminum foil and swish my brush in that.  I fold my foil up and refill it has necessary.  I have no mess in my bathroom as fine powders tend to fly around!  I'd recommend this over far more expensive setting powders I've used.

reviews.t: The best setting powder I've ever used
reviews.x: The best setting powder I've ever used, and I've used a lot of different ones ranging from Urban Decay to Covergirl. My sister is a make up artist for weddings and photo shoots. She turned me on to Ben Nye, this companies powder is amazing. Sets well and only has to be applied once a day. It's the best thing since sliced bread. :)

This is a great setting powder. I know there are many out there, and I happened to see this recommended in a youtube video. It goes on nice, works well, and lasts all day. Doesn't leave a residue--no shininess, sparkliness, or color. A great setting powder to go over foundation or BB cream.
Way better than any of the high def powders, sets your makeup invisibly, no photo 'ghosting'.  Always use over my foundation/blush and spray rosewater&water to 'set'.  Looks natural.

I've heard RAVES about this stuff... But honestly, it's just clear setting powder... Same as all the others. The packaging was very bad and when I took off the "protective" plastic cap, TONS of product flew onto my clothes and all over my dresser and carpet. I'd opt for a cheaper product with simpler, more convenient packaging.

reviews.t: Fine powder with flawless finish - great in humid weather
reviews.x: My wife bought this to use for our wedding in Bora Bora.  She was concerned about the humidity and making sure her make up was photo-ready, no "flash back" effort.  She was so impressed with the fine powder, it does not crease in her fine lines and gives a nice finish without the look of a mannequin.  She used the Banana Powder from Ben Nye as well for the wedding, gave a flawless look in 80% humid weather!

reviews.t: I will continue to use this product
reviews.x: For years I have been looking for a powder to set my makeup.  No matter if it was a drug store brand or a powder from the most expensive Sephora/Department Store product, they were all too heavy and sat in the fine wrinkles.  This powder is SPECTACULAR!  It does not appear as if you have used powder.  A little goes a long way and it last all day.

Amazing! No breakouts, no touch ups, no cakey makeup.  I finally found a product that seals in place my makeup and balances my super oily/combo skin.  I use it everyday to seal my foundation and it works great.  It works with BB creams too.
This is a great, light weight powder that isn't going to build up. I use this all over in combination with banana powder. Ben Nye's powders are true to their name.

My skin didn't appear blotchy at the end of the day, but it did look a bit oily. I have combination skin with most of my facial oils appearing in my T areas (chin, nose, area between the eyebrows). I applied the powder at 6:00 am and by 2:45pm I noticed that my skin was oily. However, it may just possibly be that I need to apply a heavier coat of powder than what I used.

If you're seeing white patches, you applied too much and haven't spread it out properly. A nice fluffy brush does the trick.  The only reason I don't like this product is that the bottle doesn't really have an easy opening to use a brush with. claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the powder for keeping makeup set and matte all day, often noting it outperforms high-end alternatives.
Several reviewers describe the powder as truly translucent, going on clear without leaving a white or ashy cast across different skin tones.
A notable number of reviewers suspect the product is counterfeit or not genuine Ben Nye, citing mismatched packaging, off consistency, and skin irritation.
Some reviewers report the powder did not control shine as long as expected or lightened their face, with one saying it broke them out.
A few reviewers mention packaging issues, such as a mouth too small for a brush or a poorly designed cap that spilled product.
